'''Bunt Dantor''' was a [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoan]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who worked at the [[Techno Union Research and Development Wing]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="HNNAGD">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/hnn/001.html#rss|text=HoloNet News — A Galaxy Divided|int=HoloNet News — A Galaxy Divided}}</ref>

==Biography==
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Dantor was part of a panel debate discussing the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist's]] [[Malevolence/Legends|mysterious new weapon]]. Based on the lack of applause, Dantor was not highly thought of.

During the debate, it was Dantor who brought up the possibility of the use of an [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] in conjunction with conventional secondary weaponry, as the technology behind the mysterious attacks. He estimated the size of a warship capable of destroying entire [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] task forces to be at 17 kilometers in length, given its power-supply. This estimate conflicted with those made by fellow panelists, [[Umak Leth]] and [[Nasdra Magrody]].<ref name="HNNAGD" />

He often relayed facts in a monotone, mechanized voice, as he wore an [[Pressure suit/Legends|environmental pressure suit]], like all Skakoans living off-world.<ref name="HNNAGD" />
